result_text:
The export now builds `all_files.zip` from the same names the loose files are written under, so renaming an aspect in `config.json` no longer drops the zip. The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in the `exportJson` block that writes `all_files.zip`.

The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are replaced by a loop over the main, test, generated, build and deployment, and other aspects. Each entry name comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that names the loose files, and the file is read under that name. Default names and order are unchanged.

`mvn -o -pl reports test` compiles the module and `ReportFileExporterTest` passes. No test covers this export path, so I did not verify the renamed-aspect case (`aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` in the zip, `git-history.zip` written). Running a full analysis with the renamed config would confirm it.

I did not commit.
